environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'diagnostics-prod' fronted by Envoy-based API gateway (Gloo Edge 1.14) with request transformation and validation policy. The gateway has a VirtualService with a jsonschema-validation option on the transcoded REST endpoint that enforces the 'options' field matches pattern '^-[a-zA-Z]{1,2}(\s+[0-9]{1,4})?$' via Gloo's request validation filter (envoy.filters.http.ext_proc with OPA sidecar evaluating rego policy 'diagnostics/input_schema/v2'). The transcoding layer converts REST to gRPC before forwarding to the pod - direct gRPC access to the pod is blocked by Cilium L7 network policy requiring the x-envoy-internal header set only by the gateway. Additionally, the OPA rego policy validates that the 'options' field length is ≤6 characters and contains no semicolons, pipes, ampersands, or newline characters.

config.network_policy: Cilium L7 - pod only accepts traffic with x-envoy-internal header from gateway pod CIDR
